base_registry.note: The shared registry has no Norwegian scope, so this supplement adds NO without altering it.

evidence.note: Oslo municipality fixes no separate public holiday; the national scope is the host scope. Easter week 2027 runs 25-29 March with five section 2 holidays (Maundy Thursday to Easter Monday), and 17 May 2027 is also Whit Monday, so the 06:00-13:00 event ban does apply that day through the Whit Monday rule, not the Constitution Day rule. Re-read 2026-11-26 from the Lovdata consolidation; the public layer covers every dated 2027 observance in §2 and the 1/17 May act.
evidence.observed_facts: Section 2 makes every ordinary Sunday a holiday and lists the named days. Section 3 sets holiday peace from 00:00 to 24:00. Section 4 bans public events or performances between 06:00 and 13:00 on a holiday, which affects any 09:00 start that falls on one of them. The 1 and 17 May act makes those two dates equal to Sundays but expressly excludes them from the holiday-peace rules.
